```{=html}
<style>
  .viz-intro {
    color: #555;
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    max-width: 620px;
  }
  .viz-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px;
    border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }
  .viz-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 22px 16px 18px;
    background: #fff;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    color: #2c3e50 !important;
    border-right: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    position: relative;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .viz-card:hover {
    background: #f0f7fa;
    text-decoration: none !important;
  }
  .viz-card svg {
    width: 72px;
    height: 56px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .viz-card-number {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: #18bc9c;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    font-family: monospace;
  }
  .viz-card-title {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.35;
    color: #2c3e50;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .viz-card-sub {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #999;
  }
  .viz-card-arrow {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 12px;
    right: 14px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #ccc;
    transition: color 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .viz-card:hover .viz-card-arrow { color: #18bc9c; transform: translateX(3px); }
</style>

<p class="viz-intro">Interactive charts and plots for communicating benefit–risk trade-offs, patient characteristics, and clinical outcomes.</p>

<div class="viz-grid">

  <!-- 01 Pyramid Chart -->
  <a href="R/pyramid_chart.qmd" class="viz-card">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 72 56" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <!-- left bars (teal) -->
      <rect x="18" y="6"  width="16" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="14" y="12" width="20" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="10" y="18" width="24" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="8"  y="24" width="26" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="10" y="30" width="24" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="14" y="36" width="20" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="18" y="42" width="16" height="4" fill="#5bbcb0" rx="1"/>
      <!-- right bars (tan) -->
      <rect x="38" y="6"  width="14" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="38" y="12" width="18" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="38" y="18" width="22" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="38" y="24" width="24" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="38" y="30" width="20" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="38" y="36" width="16" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="38" y="42" width="12" height="4" fill="#c8b87a" rx="1"/>
      <!-- center line -->
      <line x1="36" y1="4" x2="36" y2="48" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="0.75"/>
    </svg>
    <div class="viz-card-number">01</div>
    <div class="viz-card-title">Pyramid Chart</div>
    <div class="viz-card-sub">Demographics</div>
    <span class="viz-card-arrow">→</span>
  </a>

  <!-- 02 Line Chart -->
  <a href="R/line_chart.qmd" class="viz-card">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 72 56" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

      <rect x="6" y="22" width="60" height="14" fill="#d4d4d4" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="6" y="36" width="60" height="12" fill="#bdbdbd" rx="1"/>
      <!-- curve -->
      <path d="M6 10 Q20 12 30 22 Q45 36 66 48" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
      <!-- arrows -->
      <line x1="18" y1="14" x2="36" y2="14" stroke="#c07020" stroke-width="1.2" marker-end="url(#arr2)"/>
      <line x1="22" y1="26" x2="44" y2="26" stroke="#c07020" stroke-width="1.2" marker-end="url(#arr2)"/>
      <line x1="28" y1="38" x2="52" y2="38" stroke="#c07020" stroke-width="1.2" marker-end="url(#arr2)"/>
      <defs>
        <marker id="arr2" viewBox="0 0 8 8" refX="7" refY="4" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
          <path d="M1 1L7 4L1 7" fill="none" stroke="#c07020" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        </marker>
      </defs>
    </svg>
    <div class="viz-card-number">02</div>
    <div class="viz-card-title">Line Chart</div>
    <div class="viz-card-sub">Disease History</div>
    <span class="viz-card-arrow">→</span>
  </a>

  <!-- 03 Grouped Bar Chart -->

      <!-- group 1 -->
      <rect x="10" y="40" width="5" height="8"  fill="#b8dab5" rx="1"/>

    <svg viewBox="0 0 72 56" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
```
